message.content:
LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes in the history of the sport. Born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, he played high school basketball at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School, where he gained national attention and was named the USA Today High School Player of the Year. 

He entered the NBA directly from high school in 2003, being selected first overall by the Cleveland Cavaliers. LeBron has since played for the Miami Heat (winning two NBA championships), returned to the Cavaliers (winning a third championship in 2016), and currently plays for the Los Angeles Lakers. He has earned numerous accolades, including multiple NBA Most Valuable Player awards, NBA Finals MVPs, and All‑NBA selections. 

Beyond the court, LeBron is known for his philanthropy—most notably the LeBron James Family Foundation, which opened the “I Promise School” in Akron—and his ventures in entertainment, media, and business.
